This is no longer just a mission. It's personal.

title: In Love, In Silence
description:
"Queenie James lost her parents at a young age and was left to suffer under the cruel hands of her uncle and aunt. She managed to get into university—only to face new hardships due to her poverty and inability to speak.A chance encounter brought Harrison Fletcher, a cold and powerful CEO, into her life. Moved by her resilience, he stepped into her world and offered her a way out.
In Harrison's world, Queenie found something she had never dared to hope for: care, respect, and a family that accepted her for who she was. As their bond deepened, she learned that even those without a voice could be heard—when someone truly listened."

Back in her father’s empire, she agrees to meet Dante Moretti, the ruthless mafia don who offers the respect Adrian never did. As Adrian uncovers Celeste’s betrayal and tears the world apart searching for Valentina, he discovers too late that the woman he took for granted may soon belong to his most dangerous rival.

title: Married in Disguise
description: Gigi Jaffe hides her identity as the CEO of Minley Corp and goes for a blind date in hopes to find a good man, while Leo Burke is the head of Chilton Corp who pretends to be a poor guy because he does not want a gold-digger as his wife. The two of them find each other a great match, not knowing that their respective companies are business partners, and they almost get their own hidden identities exposed multiple times.

title: Mon gigolo est le boss !(doublage)
description: La famille Durand retrouve sa vraie fille et chasse Mélanie Durand de la maison. Son mari nominal est parti à l'étranger avec sa maîtresse. Seule au monde, Mélanie se complaît chaque jour dans les bras de son gigolo Aurélien Simon. Lorsque son mari annonce son retour, Mélanie rompt avec Aurélien. C'est alors qu'elle découvre qu'Aurélien est en fait le célèbre Prince.

title: The Legendary Mage Returns
description: Three years ago, transcendent S-rank legend Aiden fell, cursed and amnesiac by the Devouring Abyss. Radiant Academy prodigy Irene risked her life with Soul Link to wake his memories and power. Wielding a simple training staff, he beats rivals from five academies and exposes traitor Lance. He and Irene unleash Ice-Thunder Twin Soul Resonance to slay the Abyss Nine-Headed Demon God and Maeve. At last, he crowns Irene with the S-rank Guardian Sacred Crown.

title: Golden Dragon Mother’s Rampage
description:
In my past life, I was a pure-blooded white dragon who gave everything to help him seize the throne—only to have that hypocrite  Igon  sever my wings, steal my child, shatter my egg, and summon heavenly thunder to strike me down. With my dying breath, I swore on my blood: if I ever returned, I would make him pay a hundredfold!

I open my eyes to find myself back at the royal consort selection ceremony—the very day he chose my half-sister Jean  instead, and tried to ruin my name with a so-called "divine prophecy." Fine. I sneak straight into the forbidden depths and claim the legendary ancient Golden Dragon, Cedric, as my mate—conceiving the supreme dragon heir!

The scumbag gloats as his egg hatches a golden dragon, taunting me that my black egg could only produce a lowly black dragon. But when my egg cracks open—a rainbow-colored Supreme Saint Dragon emerges, crushing his shadowy black dragon whelp in an instant! With our bet sealed, I raise my blade and sever his wings, ripping off his false golden dragon disguise for all to see—

Wait. The "black dragon" mate I picked up on a whim… is the undisputed pinnacle of all dragonkind?!

"My dear, for the sake of saving dragon bloodline, we'll just have to try a few more times." He chuckles, pulling me closer by the waist.

This rebirth? Totally worth it.

description: Xiao Yao, a carefree girl who embarks on a fantastical journey in the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons. Hong Ye, the formidable King is reborn to safeguard the valley. Hong Ye appreciates Xiao Yao's pure heart, untainted by desires.

title: Marching -Asu e-
description: Yokohama Xebec is a marching band of a port city, Yokohama. The band goes by the philosophy, 'One for all. All for one.' Band captain Mari, is determined to win this year's national competition. But when the band's lead trumpeter, Tadanobu, announces his decision to leave the band after the season to pursue music as a professional, it causes a stir among the members. Tadanobu's family is currently hosting his aunt and his cousin, Yukie and Yosuke, who have fled the tsunami stricken Fukushima. This movie features the bond between the people of Iwabune and the members of Yokohama's marching band. As the national competition approaches, the young people of two port towns come together through music and take an unexpected action...

title: Oghab-e Sahra
description: An Historical story which take place in the 7th century Arabia from Houdaybeh peace treaty till conquer of Mecca by Muslims, and tells the story of a man whose name is Abu Basir.

title: Level E
description: In the present day, hundreds of extraterrestrial species walk the Earth. Some are pacifistic, others violent. Some are here for research purposes, others are career criminals. However, humans don't know they are here. Now, one more alien has arrived on Earth. One of the universe's foremost geniuses with a personality that's bound to attract all sorts of trouble.

title: Deedar-E-Yaar
description: Two close and devout Muslim youth, Javed and Akhtar, are childhood pals. They both unknowingly fall in love with the same woman, Firdaus. Since Akhtar is wealthy, and comes from a noble family, the girl's dad, Nawab Mirza, decides that she should marry Akhtar. She is reluctant to do so, but finally agrees when she is threatened. Akhtar has not yet seen Firdaus, but finds out that Javed also loves her, and he decides to marry her, and promptly divorce her by saying "Talaq" three times, so that Javed can marry her later. Javed is delighted with this idea and goes along with it, not knowing that Firdaus is Akhtar's dreamgirl, and he may not be able to keep his word and divorce her.

title: Kaarzar-e-Dua
description: Kaarzar-e-Dua is a timeless love story about two people who are deeply in love but are torn apart by conspiracies and unexpected twists of fate. Despite everything, their love stays strong and keeps pulling them back to each other. Raazi is a kind and sincere young man who lives with his uncle and aunt. Their daughter, Tanno, is deeply in love with him and dreams of spending her life by his side. Although they are already married, the family is waiting for Raazi to become financially stable before holding the final wedding ceremony. But things take a dark turn when people who are against Raazi plan to ruin his life. Their conspiracy leads to Raazi being forced out of his own house. He is left heartbroken and alone. As he begins a new and tough phase of life, he faces one challenge after another.

title: Khakestar-e sabz
description: Hadi travels to Croatia to complete his researches on Film making. His friend Aziz who has heard about his trip gives him a photo and a VHS cassette asking him to look after a girl Fatemeh there. Hadi with the help of a woman Hanifeh who can talk Persian searches for the girl. Croatian police arrest Hadi and because of his visa problems expelled him from the country. He then with Hanifeh go to Bosnia to complete his search after Fatemeh but involved in the Bosnia's war and get injured.

title: Solteira e Boa Rapariga
description: Carla (Lúcia Moniz) is a 40 year old Portuguese girl. Single and ready to mingle, she studied modern literature, got a job at a book publisher - which lasted a short time - and ended up dedicating herself to translation. Lives in a small apartment - in Campo de Ourique, heritage of her grandmother - has two cats (Pablo and Mimi) and never got married. She has never been a lucky girl in love, nor even in the game. In fact, Carla has never been very lucky with anything in her life. Shy by nature, she rarely goes out, rarely has a dinner out, rarely travels and rarely believes that any miracle can happen to her life. Until her fortieth birthday when her mother (Helena Isabel), offers her a voucher to spend in a fortuneteller.

title: Reis e Ratos
description: Estado do Rio de Janeiro, 1963. O coreto da praça principal de Bacaxá explode no momento de abertura da gincana de primavera da pequena cidade. O alvo do atentando é Amélia Castanho, cantora de boate escolhida para a tarefa da efeméride anual. Segundos antes de o coreto ir pelos ares, ela escuta do rádio do automóvel uma bizarra transmissão: o locutor, em transe, revela o plano que pretendia vitimá-la pela explosão onde ela deveria estar mas não estava! Assim começa Reis e Ratos. A partir daí, a narrativa quebrada em flashbacks nos traz de volta até a explosão do coreto e seu desfecho. A trama e suas situações conduzem o espectador pela atmosfera conspiratória das vésperas do Golpe Militar de 1964. A narrativa suja e delirante de Reis e Ratos ocorre numa certa antessala do cenário golpista. A história é contada através dos pontos de vista de um grupo de personagens de alguma forma ligados à direita. Esse grupo de pessoas é parte de um plano pra tirar o presidente do governo sem que o uso do dispositivo militar, tanto golpista quando legalista, precise ser empreendido. (Fonte: site oficial do filme)

title: David F.
description: Black is scientifically the absence of color, but not all who see it are color-blind. David F. weaves three stories that take a look at the lineage of African-Americans in the Philippines--from American soldiers in the Philippine-American war to the Amerasians in the former Clark Air Base, and how we Pinoys take to them. It begins with the Philippine-American war in the early 1900's when two Filipinos want to get the reward money for capturing David Fagen, the African-American soldier who deserted the U.S. army to join the Filipino revolutionaries against the new colonizers. Another thread of the film looks at the life of a Filipina during the Japanese occupation before the return of General Douglas MacArthur in 1944 who gives birth to a baby that turns out to be black-skinned. Finally, in contemporary times, a black gay impersonator in a comedy bar, whose father is an African-American soldier based in Clark Air Base in Angeles City, tries to find his father who abandoned him. In the course of history, the "F" in "David F." may spell different levels of discrimination. But would we also admit that we Filipinos are bigots ourselves?

title: F for Fontcuberta
description: Many truths are hidden to contemporary man. So it happens few are aware that the most ferocious predator is a rare species of oyster, that some amongst the most famous Soviet astronauts have been erased by History, that mermaids once truly existed in the French Alps. But in Barcelona there is a man who, despite himself, is the keeper of these uneasy truths: the Catalan photographer Joan Fontcuberta. The mockumentary F for Fontcuberta is a journey in the creative world of one of the most flamboyant contemporary artists and his incredible discoveries. A trip in the misty no mans land between fake and reality. Dedicated to the sceptics of all the world.

title: F--kland
description: Fabián, a magician from Buenos Aires, saves his money from weddings, birthdays, and bar mitzvahs, and uses a hidden camera to document a week-long trip to the Falkland Islands where he has a patriotic plan: to impregnate a British woman. If 500 Argies do this annually, the islands will soon be overrun with children belonging to both cultures. He spends his first couple of days in Stanley doing reconnaissance, setting his sights on Camila, whom he's first seen in church. He chats her up at an Internet café. They go out for drinks, then dinner, then to the see the King penguins and a 1982 battlefield. Back home, editing his Dogma 95 film, he receives a final message from Camila.

title: F-3
description: A life of war and murder plague the mind and inevitably descend the soul into the very depths of Hell for answers. F-3 is the question.

title: F#cking 40
description: By 40 you'd think most men would have figured out a thing or two about life. But for four childhood friends navigating (mid)life in LA, turning 40 only proves that nobody has any f#cking clue what they're doing.

title: Legends of F1
description: The Legends of Formula 1 is a thrilling documentary that takes viewers on a high-octane journey through the history of one of the world's most prestigious motorsports. Featuring iconic drivers from different eras, it delves into the lives and careers of racing legends like Ayrton Senna, Michael Schumacher, Lewis Hamilton, and others who defined the sport. Through rare footage, interviews with drivers, teams, and experts, and behind-the-scenes stories, the documentary captures the drama, triumphs, and tragedies that shaped Formula 1, showcasing how these champions pushed the limits of speed and innovation to etch their names into motorsport history.

title: Pretty Cure All Stars F
description: A great Pretty Cure gathering!. Or so we thought. They've actually been separated!? "Where am I...?" When Sora wakes up, she finds herself in a mysterious world... It seems that she has lost Mashiro and the others.... But there she meets Yui, Manatsu, and Prim!. What's more, Prim transforms into Cure Supreme!. Mashiro meets Laura, Amane, and Nodoka on a small island in the sea, and rescues Puka from a monster attack!. Tsubasa meets Saaya, Ha-chan, and Haruka, where they take a walk in the hanging garden!. Ageha meets Asumi, Lala and Yukari, but Lala and Yukari are having trouble getting along!. They meet a lot of friends, but for some reason, their memories are all a little hazy... And it seems that the only people in this world are Precure...? We want to go back to our own world!. The clue is a castle in the distance Onward!. Our journey begins here!. Let's go on a great adventure to the castle!.

title: G-Taste
description: Volume #1: A Taste of Honey (Eps #1-3) Although she tries hard, lovely office worker Moe bungles her assignments more often than not. She’d fare better if she spent more time working and less time playing with the office equipment, but it wouldn’t be near as much fun. Nana’s so cute in her maid’s outfit that it’s easy to see why everyone wants a piece of her. And while domineering Mai is used to being the boss, she’s going to discover the joys of humiliation. A taste will only leave you wanting more, so obey your sweet tooth. Volume #2: Heat Wave (Eps #4-7) Sayaka is trying to be a prim and proper teacher, but every time she steps in front of a classroom she gets hot… And turning up the air conditioner isn’t going bring her temperature down one bit. Misuzu may be a world-class swimmer, but the cold water in the practice pool only heats things up. She’s one bathing beauty who doesn’t need a sauna to make things steamy. The heat index will soar as these two lovely ladies do their best to set the screen on fire.

description: An upcoming Indian Gujarati-language action film directed by Mayur Kachhadiya and produced by Mahendra Patel under their banner of Ashadeep Cine Productions. title: G is for Gun: The Arming of Teachers in America
description: Since the Sandy Hook massacre in 2012, schools in as many as 13 states have started arming teachers as a security measure. How did this happen, and what does it mean for American education? G is for Gun follows the story of teachers being trained to kill, and a small city in western Ohio divided by bringing arms into its schools.

title: Swag G Style
description: Swag G Style follows the lives of six gay/bisexual men in Dallas, Texas. We explore their friendships, business lives and how they cope day to day with the stigma of being gay and black in America. G Style Swagg is a reality series that allows the viewer a inside look at the hearts of 6 friends dealing the complications of life from coming out or not, and how it affects their day to day dealings in love, friendships, family and business. The intent of the show is to build a bridge of tolerance between the gay and straight communities.

title: When G-Men Step In
description: Fred Garth (Don Terry) owns a printing establishment and poses as a business research expert, but actually runs several white-collar rackets operating by means of high-pressure telephone soliciting. He has sent his younger brother, Bruce Garth (Robert Paige), through law school with the intention of making him his legal watch-dog. But idealist Bruce enrolls as a Department of Justice investigator, and is detailed to track down charity and other phoney rackets. Both brothers are in love with attractive socialite Marjorie Drake (Julie Bishop as Jacqueline Wells), who is unaware of Fred's schemes and he uses her to meet other social leaders with pet charities and his salesmen sell them the program ads at five times the charity rate. Bruce and his partner Neale (Gene Morgan) trace the phone rackets to Bruce and a confrontation looms.

title: Milky G
description:
Michael Farlow (Milky G), like a lot of teens from the new millennium, aspire to be rappers; however growing up on the streets of Los Angeles in a crime infested neighborhood, played against Milky's goal of making it big. After witnessing his mother getting killed during a drug raid, the trauma lingers in his mind as several years pass. Milky moves out of his old neighborhood and into the suburbs entering a new charter high school of mostly white students.

Milky G meets a girl [SANDY HOLMES] in his class, a classical music major, who he falls in lust with. She gets him into the schools "world talent show", but Milky G can't stay away from the old neighborhood and ghetto friends. The relationship gets stormy. Milky G rejects the boogie world and while suppressing the pain of his mother's memory, continues to hang out, run the streets, make fast money, and craft his rapper identity. Milky's behavior and bad attitude lead to constant clashes with the police and court appearances. Milky makes a rap demo for the talent show with the help of Big Stack, studio owner, a legend in his own right in the world of hip-hop. Big Stack, knowing Milky's past - becomes his mentor.

Although Milky is focused on his music, he can't stay away from a life of crime. He needs some flash money so he can acquire that rapper look and get his props at the talent show. This all comes to a head when Milky G is talked into robbing a drug dealers house and it doesn't go good. Gangsters are after him and the police are too. Weary, and with nowhere to turn, Milky G. leans on what Big Stack taught him about life and decides to undo the harm he's done to himself and others. Repentant, he ends up at his mother's grave begging for forgiveness and promising to make things right. Although he's been scratched from the talent show, he forces his way onto the stage to give a rap tribute to his mother. The crowd goes wild, but he doesn't win. Milky G gains SANDY's favor as well as those close to him who want him to take a different path and become the man he was meant to be. Risking his life he decides to return the stolen goods to the thugs.

title: Mythos Ot(h)ello
description: Kaum einer hatte wohl noch mit einem solchen Spätwerk von Giuseppe Verdi gerechnet: Als 1887 die Uraufführung von "Otello" stattfand, hatte er 16 Jahre lang keine Oper mehr geschrieben. Warum hatte Verdi sich ausgerechnet von der Geschichte des schwarzen Generals, der Opfer einer Intrige wird und aus falscher Eifersucht seine Frau ermordet, angezogen gefühlt? Shakespeares Dramenvorlage "Othello" ist sicherlich eines der größten Meisterwerke der Theatergeschichte. Aus heutiger Sicht ist es spannend und erhellend zu ergründen, was die beiden Meister ihres Fachs an einem schwarzen Titelhelden faszinierte und wie sie mit ihm umgehen. Welche Rolle spielten Schwarze in der Welt, in der Shakespeare und Verdi lebten? Welchen Einfluss hatte der Hintergrund des Kolonialzeitalters, das in England in Shakespeares Epoche und in Italien zu Verdis Lebzeiten anbrach? Wie wurde dieser erste schwarze Titelheld der Theater- und Operngeschichte seither dargestellt und was sagt das über die Vorstellung "Weißer" von "Schwarzen" aus? Diesen Fragen widmet sich die ARTE-Dokumentation "Mythos Ot(h)ello". Jonas Kaufmann und Antonio Pappano führen durch Verdis geniales Musikdrama. Experten und Expertinnen beleuchten die historischen Hintergründe sowohl der Oper wie Shakespeares Stücks. Fußballlegende Jimmy Hartwig, der nach seiner Sportlerlaufbahn eine Karriere als Schauspieler machte, erzählt, was Ot(h)ello mit seiner Rassismuserfahrung und seinem Leben zu tun hat.

title: H: Murmur
description: Serial killer Shin-Hyun gives himself up to police and confesses to committing a series of particularly horrifying murders of exclusively female victims. He is imprisoned and awaiting the death sentence but the killings continue, with the same characteristics of the Shin-Hyun serial killings. The case is re-opened when two more bodies are discovered, both pregnant women; one found in the city's landfill site and the other was horrifically murdered on a public bus. Detective Mi Yun (Yum Jung-Ah) and her newly-appointed partner Detective Kang (Ji Jin-Hee) are assigned to the case. Mi Yun and Kang have difficulty working with each other; their personalities and working methods constantly clash. Detective Kang goes about his new job buoyantly and enthusiastically. He follows a new suspect, Huh, and eventually catches him in the act of brutally murdering a woman in a crowded techno bar. Huh is taken into custody after Kang shoots and wounds him at the crime scene. Once again, the case seems to be solved with this spectacular arrest--yet the murders continue in copy-cat style. The police desperately hunt for new leads. They start an in-depth investigation of a Doctor Chu, who is Shin-Hyun's psychiatrist, but progress is frustrated when Dr Chu becomes a victim of the copy-cat killings herself. The murdered psychiatrist's former boyfriend, a fanatical character named Choi, quickly becomes the prime suspect. All the pieces are finally starting to fit together, and the case seems almost resolved. But all efforts are suddenly frustrated once again, when Choi takes his own life--but still, the killings continue. The case gets more complicated when even the police themselves appear to become suspects in the murders. In unraveling this mystery, everyone involved is pushed to the limits of human understanding.

title: I Hate How Much I Want You
description: A shy girl secretly in love with her best friend is rejected after one passionate night. Five years later, she returns as a single mother and is forced to work for him — the cold CEO who still can't stop wanting her.

title: I Am
description: I Am is the story of a successful Hollywood director Tom Shadyac, who experienced a life threatening head injury, and his ensuing journey to try and answer two very basic questions, "What's wrong with our world?" and "What can we do about it?". Tom visits some of today's great minds, including authors, poets, teachers, religious leaders and scientists searching for the fundamental problem that causes all of the other problems, while simultaneously reflecting on his own life choices of excess, greed, and eventual healing.

title: I Mean, I Want to Say I Like It
description: Chitose, a former bullied girl who became a talent manager, is put in charge of is a domineering actor who was a bully as a child.

title: Neighborhood Witch J
description: A star in the world of internet content creation, Seo Je Yi (Park Ji Yeon) has made quite a name for herself as a beauty expert. A smooth talker who isn't afraid to tell it like it is, Je Yi has amassed an impressive following since the start of her career and the numbers just keep rising. With so many dedicated followers, companies are beginning to take notice of Je Yi, including Lee Woo Bin (Lee Tae Sun), the CEO of a cosmetics start-up company whose products Je Yi has acknowledged on more than one occasion. A highly intelligent man, Lee Woo Bin knows what it takes to run a company well but when it comes to social interaction, he has absolutely no idea what he's doing. Encouraged by Je Yi's glowing reviews of his products, Woo Bin has tried, on more than one occasion, to get better acquainted with the rising star, but every attempt he has made so far has failed miserably. Meanwhile, Lee Tae Kyung (Jang Eui Soo), the director of MCN, a company specializing in managing content creators, has taken a sudden interest in Je Yi and he's determined to win her over. With so many roads now opening before her, Je Yi must decide which path will lead to both her success and happiness. But which path should she choose when her head tells her to go one way and her heart tells her to go another? The first selection for the 2020 pilot division of the Broadcasting Content Production Support Project, "Next Door Witch J" is a 2021 Viki Original romantic drama directed by Yoon Ji Hoon.

title: Alfred J. Kwak
description: After a horrific car accident takes the lives of his parents and siblings, a young duckling is raised by his considerate uncle to be good and responsible; meanwhile, his schoolmate Dolf slowly becomes seduced by fascism.

title: J.Lo: Self Made
description: Jennifer Lopez, best known as 'J.Lo', was destined as a "Triple Threat Entertainer" for acting, song, dance. With strong Latin roots and success driven by grit, it's been a crazy ride on the way to the top for the Self-Made star.

title: The J-K Conspiracy
description: San Diego radio host Dave Rickards is accused of stealing his partner's encyclopedia, triggering a comedic misadventure co-starring Bob Costas, Dom Irrera, Doug Flutie, Davy Jones, Dr. Laura Schlessinger and Don Rickles. Along the way you are treated to spectacular shots of San Diego County, bizarre secret meetings, real-life flashbacks, radio station politics, conspiracy theories, parties, sporting events, live comedy, and homages to such classic films as "All the President's Men", "The Godfather", and "Office Space".

title: The Disc Dive with Ryan J. Downey
description: The Disc Dive, where artists dive deep into their discographies with longtime journalist Ryan J. Downey.

title: K
description: An elderly German tourist is killed in Paris at the hands of Joseph Katz, an old junk dealer beloved by detective Sam Bellamy. Despite witnessing the crime, Sam covers for Joseph, upon which the latter vanishes in mysterious circumstances.

title: K
description: 25 young people in 7 different story lines experience something seemingly everyday, but each story has a connection with cancer.

title: Our Sticky Love
description: A former boxing champion turned gang member seeks redemption as a small-town boxing coach, while becoming entangled with an amnesiac prosecutor and a complex web of lies surrounding their shared past.

title: Doroga k domu
description: An Orthodox priest, a resident of a provincial town, has for many years been unable to find answers to important questions for him, tormenting and interfering with a peaceful life. Once, having unraveled the tangle of certain events, he realizes that the answer lies in a long and difficult unforgiveness.

title: King the Land
description: Amid a tense inheritance fight, a charming heir clashes with his hardworking employee who's known for her irresistible smile, which he cannot stand.

title: K.O. Beast [English]
description: Set in the distant future in which the Earth is split in two. The southern hemisphere is placed in another dimension while the inhabitants of the northern hemisphere are able to morph into beast-like humanoids. Eventually the humans of the southern hemisphere, led by Uranus, attack the Beasts. The Three Beasts, Wan Derbard (Wan Dabadadatta) of the Tiger Tribe, Bud Mint (Baado Mint) of the Bird Tribe, and Mei Mer (Mei Mah) of the Mermaid Tribe, are taken prisoner along with Mei Mer's companion Tuttle Millen (Mekka Mannen, also of the Mermaid tribe), but manage to escape thanks to a little girl named Yuuni Charm Password. Together they seek Gaia, which they believe to be a fabulous treasure, but they are pursued by Uranus's minions : V-Darn the vicious mage-knight, V-Sion the warrior woman and Akumako, V-Darn's sadistic imp-like partner.

title: Wir Sind vom K u K Infanterie-Regiment
description: A Viennese architect opposes his girlfriend's ambitions as a cabaret singer and turns away from her to do his duty in the infantry and prepare for war.

description: A teenage outcast is uprooted from his residence and forced to confront terrifying monsters intent on eradicating humanity. As he battles against impossible odds, he discovers the strength to fight for survival and to protect others.

title: The Studio K Show
description: Following a cast of characters from Studio K in the Canadian Broadcasting Centre.

title: K-Town
description: Three couples. Two Reporters. One question. Why are East Asians so popular? Rochelle Evans ask this question after her friend Karen Blackwell loses her boyfriend of two years to an East Asian girl. The two set out to follow three East-Asian-including interracial couples for sixty days in their day to day lives to find out what is the secret to this phenomenon.

title: Music Bank K-Chart
description: Music Bank K-Chart is KBS's long-run music chart show that airs live every Friday. The Top 50 songs of the week are featured on K-Chart. Every week, various K-pop artists come on the show to showcase their music and dance moves. It's a concert of all the popular artists that you can watch in the comfort of your home. From newly debuted rookies, artists making a comeback from their hiatus, indie bands, globally recognized idol groups, and much more, they will be able to satisfy your needs for K-pop. With eye-catching performances and melody that will echo in your heart, this music festival can provide viewing pleasure for those who are not even familiar with K-pop. Tune in every week and pay attention to see which artist and song wins the most popular song of the week.

title: Perfect Crown [Hindi]
description: In a modern Korea with a constitutional monarchy, a Chaebol heiress and a powerless prince enter a contract marriage, discovering love and courage as they confront social barriers and personal scars.

title: My Strange Hero [Hindi]
description: When Kang Bok Soo was a high school student, he was falsely accused of committing violence and kicked out of school. This was caused by his first love Son Soo-Jeong and a male student Oh Se Ho. Kang Bok Soo is a now an adult, but his life has not gone smoothly. To get revenge on Son Soo-Jeong and Oh Se Ho, he returns to the same high school as a student. The environment at the school has changed and Kang Bok Soo gets involved in unexpected cases.

title: K: The Unknown
description: Sidney Page is a beautiful young nurse, the object of the romantic attentions of several young men in her small town. One of them, a mysterious fellow known as K, suddenly finds that the life of his rival for Sidney's hand depends upon his revealing the secret of his own past.

title: Melting Me Softly
description: A man and a woman participate in a 24-hour human freezing experiment. Due to a mysterious plan, the couple awakens 20 years later.

title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas [Hindi]
description: "Four Hands" is a piano term that refers to a technique where two people play a single piano together. The drama will depict the friendship, love, rivalry, and growth of youths who meet at an arts high school, following their journey from adolescence to adulthood as professional pianists. Set in an arts high school, the series follows Kang Bi-o, Chae Jeong-yo, and Jae-in as they grow from their school days into adulthood.

title: F#@K I Love U
description: F#@k I Love U is a dramatic tale of a modern family that gets quickly pulled into a spiral of interconnected events that test the limits of their bond and mutual love. Douglas Winston is, by all appearances, the perfect family man. A well groomed and successful black politician, he, his wife white Angie, and their two sons, James and Michael, seem to lead idyllic lives that quickly begin to unravel when Douglas visits his brother J, an white irresponsible would be actor with heavy drug and sex habits. After a jeopardizing incident endangers all of their lives, Douglas is quick to blame J and his irresponsible nature, but in trying to delve into the actual truth, the strands that hold his life together quickly start to unravel into a downward spiral of twisted connections, tangled love, and intrigue that will put to the test the true limits of his faith in those he loves and who he believes in.

title: The Scholar Who Walks the Night
description: Jo Yang-sun disguises himself as a bookseller after the fall of his family. Meet Kim Sung-yeol, a vampire obsessed with his former love's double Choi Hye-ryung. The evil vampire Gwi conspires to deny the ascension of the Crown Prince.

description: The story takes place in Joseon period, when power struggles surrounding the throne had reached extreme levels. In order to escape those who plan to assassinate him, the King puts a clown, who looks exactly like him, on the throne.

title: Pammal K. Sambandam
description: A single movie stuntman attempts to save the marriage of his hen-pecked brother.

title: Schweik gotovitsya k boyu
description: Czech patriots are planning to rescue their colleague from the torture chambers of the Gestapo. After staging a wedding, they gather in one of the local pubs. Schweik, who plays the role of the groom, will have to play for time, entertaining the audience with stories of French patriots. The operation ends successfully, and the brave soldier again manages to fool the Nazis.

title: Doctor on the Edge
description: Elite South Korean medical students serve mandatory military duty as public health doctors. Plastic surgeon Do Ji Ui is sent to isolated Pyeondong-do island, where bizarre events unfold from his first day. Can he survive the year?

title: See You at Work Tomorrow! [Hindi]
description: Depicts the story of Cha Ji Yun, a seventh-year office worker stuck in a career slump, who chooses her prickly boss, Kang Si U, as the "lesser evil" to avoid the "worst." Together, they grow to become each other's irreplaceable "best."

title: The Flute of Love [Starr. Chioma Chukwuka & Daniel K Daniel]
description: When the gods decree, who are we, mere mortals; to question the will of the gods. The movie flute of love possesses an unusual kind of epic story; a type done with rich vusuals, impassioned functionality aimed for a deeper impact on the targeted audience.In the movie, three great men have been nominated by the gods to perform the most challenging and unbelievable task which qualifies each of them to be selected as the royal groom for the beautiful amiable princess of the bride. As challenging and tough as their task appears, one man must eventually conquer against all odds. This masterpiece is indeed an overwhelming tale of surprise, discovery and reawakening. The gods do not make make errors and all destinies fall into their divine plan.

title: A Questionable Protagonist
description: The city of Los Angeles is heavily divided into two zones: rich and poor. Crime is at its peak in the poor zone. Ex-NAVY SEAL Kyle H. Holmes is a washed up drunk living in the rich zone, he was the face of the African war campaign. After stumbling into the poor zone Kyle soon finds himself killing all those who cause crime in the poor zone, this becomes Kyle's new source for adrenalin and purpose, with Kyle killing, gang members, rapists and drug dealers, he of course makes enemies, including the corrupt cops and the notorious drug and crime lord, cocaine n' coco pops.

title: Gu Family Book
description: Human/were-fox half-breed Choi Kang Chi discovers the truth about his origins and searches for the mystical Gu Family Book, which holds the secret to becoming fully human.

title: Big Daddy
description: A visitor to the Everglades swamps in Florida encounters and falls in love with an uneducated girl. But he finds competition for her affections from the unlikely and mysterious A. Beauregard Lincoln. He also discovers danger from nature in the form of vicious alligators and from the mystical in the form of a voodoo witch doctor.

title: Twelve
description: Twelve angels live as humans protecting Korea from evil spirits. After sealing dark forces in hell through sacrifice, they brought peace. Now, as evil awakens, chaos returns. Based on zodiac animals.

title: Saptrang
description: Avinash, a businessman and poet, plans a trip to find the girl of his dreams where he meets a painter and a musician. His life takes a turn when he learns how to live life from nature.

title: Happily N'ever After 2: Snow White: Another Bite at the Apple
description: Fairy tales collide when Mambo and Munk tip the scales of good and evil once again. This time Princess Snow White is a misguided teenager who'd rather have fun with friends Red Riding Hood, Goldilocks and Little Bo Peep than help peasants. When Snow White's father is matched up with Lady Vain - a scheming witch brewing to rule the kingdom - Snow White becomes a thorn in Lady Vain's side. Snow White is soon tricked by Lady Vain (with Rumpelstiltskin's help) into spreading vicious gossip about the townspeople, forcing her to flee. Through rebuilding the three little pigs' houses with the seven dwarves leading the way, Snow White learns the value of helping others. Only Snow White can foil her dad's wedding to stop Lady Vain. With Mambo and Munk in tow, Snow White proves she can rule the kingdom, while bringing balance back to the scales of good and evil.

title: Pudhu Pudhu Arthangal
description: A singer (Bharathi) who is tricked into marriage by his mother-in-law, his wife (Gowri )is enormously possessive about his fame and his female fans. One day they encounter into a fight and he decides escape from home. On the way he meets someone in the bus who is also running from her life as a dancer because her husband forcefully lets her to prostitution. They both experience some random incidents together and meet an one old couple, who are still very much enjoying love and life. Eventually the old couple dies, and by watching the couple they fall in love themselves. Then Bharathi get a prank call from his PA that Gowri is ill so he returns back to home town with Jyothi. Gowri finds him with another woman and gets furious. She files for a divorce, informs media about Jyothi. Jyothi's husband gets this news comes to find Jyothi. One thing led to another Gowri finally become mentally unstable because of her own decisions. Bharathi visits her in the mental hospital with Jyothi. Jyothi then understands that Gowri really needs Bharathi and they belong to each other, Jyothi leaves Bharathi with her. Jyothi's husband becomes a cripple and understands his mistakes, reunites with jyothi in the end.

description: Fate of a short film crew vs burglar crew who just robbed a bank.

title: The Best Hit
description: A free-spirited famous idol, a struggling singer, and their crew of "twenty-something-year-olds." When they meet, it will be an orchestra of disaster.

title: Alibhabha
description: The city is being shaken by many heart-stopping crimes taking place at different places. Young women are being molested and killed with alarming frequency. Velu (Kreshna) helps his father Subramaniam (Prakash Raj) in stealing. Being seasoned thieves, they rob everything right from pins to cars. A spate of young women are murdered, and these developments rock the city. Thiagarajan (Azhagam Perumal), a tough cop, investigates the case. However, differences of opinions crop between the Police Commissioner (Biju Menon) and Thiagarajan. One day, Velu saves the commissioner from a meeting in order to steal the commissioner car's audio player, and gets acquainted with him. Velu then begins to fall for Janani (Janani), who works in a bank. One day, when Velu withdraws money, he is shocked to find the balance amount to be Rs. 5 Lakhs. It suddenly swells to Rs. 30 Lakhs and reaches Rs. 70 Lakhs. That is when Subramaniam realizes that this is no mere coincidence. Someone was smartly using them as a pawn to cover up for other more serious activities. They were being used as the 'third man', a pretty common term in criminal parlance. Before they realize, all of them are caught in the web that was laid out. Who laid it out, how and why and do they eventually come out of it forms Alibaba. Subramaniam comes to Velu's rescue and manages to find the reason behind it. When the family begins to find out the reason behind this act, it results in bloodshed and gore, eventually ending up in Velu coming across the killers of young women in the city.

title: True Beauty
description: After being bullied and discriminated because of her ugly looks, a high school girl transforms herself into a gorgeous "goddess" and quickly rises to fame after mastering the art of makeup via online tutorial videos.

title: Delhi Riots... A tale of burn & blame
description: "Riots erupted in the northeast district of Delhi in February 2020. There were claims and counterclaims as to what triggered these riots and who all were to be blamed for it," he said. "But in this din the pain, suffering and loss of those who lost their kith and kin in these riots got ignored. This film is an attempt to capture this pain and suffering as well as an attempt to probe the root cause of these riots."

title: Spring of Youth
description: When a K-pop star's band kicks him out, he enrolls in college and falls for a music student, who might be the key to his next musical venture.

title: Too Young To Love
description: Gifted cellist Yi Lan, inspired by her mother’s influence and her childhood friend Tong Xiaole, forms a trio in her first week of high school to challenge the school orchestra and perform at the annual festival. Her fiery passion for music reignites Tong Xiaole’s own dream, and as they chase their ambitions together, love, friendship, and youth blend into a heartfelt symphony of growth and hope.

title: A Barefoot Dream
description: After a series of pipe dream ventures go belly up, retired pro soccer player Kim Won-kang happens to visit East Timor, where he finds children playing the game barefoot on rocky pitches. Sensing a new business opportunity on finding the country doesn't have a single sporting goods store, he embarks on a scheme to get rich quick by purveying athletic shoes to the unshod youngsters. Sadly, no one there can afford to pay $60 for a pair of shoes, even on a generous installment plan, and before he knows it, he is reduced to coaching a team of ragged 10-year-olds and prospects are looking grim.

title: I'm the Rule
description: A powerful mafia leader navigates betrayal, love, and loyalty in the criminal underworld while concealing their true identity from those closest to them.

title: 48M
description: There were people who crossed the border at the Yalu River which only separates North Korea and China by 48 meters, risking their lives to survive.

title: 13 m²
description: José is looking for a way out of his small time banlieue deals. When he overhears a conversation between his girlfriend and her step-brother,he might just have found a very lucrative way.Together with his two best friends,he decides to attack an armored vehicle, full of cash. But everything goes wrong and they're forced into hiding in a 13 square meters bunker. There, they will have to test their friendship, their motivations, as every move outside triggers even more paranoia.

title: S&M Sally
description: Lesbian couple Jamie and Jill explore the underground world of S&M while their friends David and Lola compete to see who's cool enough to go through with a threesome.

title: Anna M.
description: In the grips of delirious illusion, Anna, a young, gentle and shy young woman convinces herself that Doctor Zanevsky is fervently in love with her. Nothing can shake her certainty... But after hope will come resentment, followed by hatred...

title: I'm Your Man
description: Leslie must deliver evidence of Richard's illegal money siphoning scam to the FBI. She's to meet with an FBI contact at a trendy party, but mistakes a loser named Jack for him.

title: M for Malaysia
description: Documents the 2018 Malaysian General Election, when the Malaysian people, led by a 92-year-old former Prime Minister, overthrew one of the longest ruling governments in the world.

title: Avenue M
description: Based on actual events, "Avenue M" relives the chilling events witnessed by friends stranded in an isolated California dessert.

title: 11M: Terror in Madrid
description: The story of the worst terrorist attack in European history. Survivors and insiders recount March 11, 2004's terrorist attack on Madrid, including the political crisis it ignited and the hunt for the perpetrators.

title: Class N Session
description: Casting "Class N Session," a new series. Synopsis: Meet Kaitlyn Johnson (Jassy Marie), an intelligent, teenage African American sophomore girl with a quick sarcastic wit to match, which fits her future aspiration of becoming a criminal lawyer, which stems from watching marathon episodes of "Law and Order" on cable with her mother. Kaitlyn's best friend since pre-K is Vanessa Hardison (Alexis Dees), who's also an intelligent African American sophomore girl who decided her own future aspiration of becoming a celebrity lawyer after watching old footage of Johnny Cochran's performance in the O. J. Simpson trial. She also has a similar sarcastic quick wit. For years, these girls used the same facial expression to communicate with each other when someone said something idiotic. Their favorite facial expression is named "The Garfield Look," which matches the bored facial expression of Garfield the Cat. Both young ladies attend Ladera Heights High School, along with their new friends, Lisa Kim (their eccentric but very smart friend), Caleb Stevens and Louis Taylor (two of the brightest class clowns you ever want to meet; think Romeo and Bullethead from "The Steve Harvey Show," with intelligence), and Cissy Bailey (their sassy Caucasian friend who was raised in the hood). This prestigious secondary school is run by Principal Bryant, a very thorough, no-nonsense principal who's fair but firm and also has an annoying tendency to pop up unannounced on her students anywhere. Principal Bryant doesn't tolerate disruptive students who waste their time in high school; she's especially strict on rules about the students not sassing their parents. Every high school student has a favorite teacher; Mr. Reevis is that favorite teacher, who uses wit to teach his U.S. Government class. With Kaitlyn and Vanessa's aspirations of becoming a criminal lawyer and celebrity lawyer, can they survive through all the trials and tribulations high school has in store for them? Watch "Class N Session" to find out.

title: Rock 'n Tokyo
description: Tokyo proposes several different levels of reality. You can find anything you can imagine there and at the same time get a new surprise at every corner. I chose to portray this amazing city through rock 'n roll music. The Japanese love and understand rock, a kind of music and a way of life they discovered during the American occupation, after World War II. Even if Japanese society still preaches uniformity and order, there is an important underground world, where people live more freely. This is the Tokyo I show in my movie. We follow 4 rock bands : Guitar Wolf, 3 good looking guys wearing black leather and sunglasses, a singer/guitar player with a devilish presence, a garage rock that is among the most intense and loudest ever heard and surprisingly- a contract with a big record company ; The 5678s, rock-a-billy queens with a wild 50s elegance who conquered the world with a memorable scene in Quentin Tarantino's Kill Bill ; the Jet Boys, led by an extreme, crazy, border-less and exhibitionist singer/guitar player ; Nine, young guys who believe in success by music - when I first met them, they played in front of Shinjuku station as if it was the last concert of their lives. The movie shows their music, but also their way of living, their style-totally faithful to rock ,n roll- and their wanderings all around the incredible city that is Tokyo.

title: Monsieur N.
description: How could Napoleon, the man of war and pioneering military strategist, meekly accept being locked up on a storm-lashed rock in the middle of the Atlantic ocean? What system of defence, and thus of attack, can he dream up to loosen his jailers' grip? On Saint Helena, the far-flung island chosen by his enemies, Napoleon fights a mysterious battle, his last and most important, and one that history has kept secret all these years.

They decide, at a dance party, to go for it all. Forget the Pro-Am; they want to try for the title that Jake felt he never deserved. title: O Velho
description: The story of a serial killer (Luiz Guilherme) who has killed 45 people. A decade after turning himself in to the police, the man, now almost 80 years old, decides to give his first interview to a reporter from the neighborhood newspaper. During the conversation, the two establish a friendly relationship. This leads to a question: is anyone capable of murder?

title: O prosfygas
description: The stepson of a lawyer, with help of a girl who loves him, healed from amnesia, which was caused due to an injury. He remembers that he has a twin brother. When he discovers, he sees with surprise that his brother has become a successful lawyer, but who will draw him to court, accusing him of burglary.

description: Commander Emanuel is a man who dedicates his life to fighting pornography. Going through financial difficulties, he finds himself obliged to rent his house to a college of girls. Over time he will find that college is actually a whorehouse.

title: O-Bi, O-Ba: The End of Civilization
description: Set in an underground dungeon inhabited by bundled, ragged human beings, after the nuclear holocaust. The story follows the wanderings of a hero through the situations of survival. People wait for the Ark to arrive and rescue them while their habitat falls apart.

title: Enchi o Banco do Além até o Limite
description:
Com a chegada do Submundo, Daniel Soares, que morreu nesse mundo em sua vida passada, renasce antes do evento com uma interface de jogo. Usando dinheiro ritual, ele abastece completamente sua conta no Submundo, adquirindo riqueza ilimitada.

Quando o Submundo finalmente desce sobre o mundo, Daniel usa sua fortuna infinita para forjar três artefatos divinos, evolui sua classe de ferreiro de nível D para Ferreiro Divino e, após três evoluções, ascende ao posto de Deus Criador. No fim, ele derrota o chefe final do mundo do Submundo.

title: O zitianos
description: In the village of Nykteremi (Thessalian plain), a few years after it was annexed to Greece, a cunning professional beggar, Jiritokostas, succeeds in exploiting the misery, fears, prejudices and ignorance of the Thessalonians.

title: "P-Pangit!" binara ang pagkanta ni JACKIE! | It's Showtime
description:
It's the first day of school para sa maraming estudyante. Raise your hand kung excited kang bumalik sa classroom suot ang uniporme! Dito sa "It's Showtime," may extra points ang mga bibo. Don't worry dahil exam, kailangan lang pasado ka sa vibe check!

Kapag um-absent sa klase, mag-submit ng Excuse Letter kay ma'am! Si Vice Ganda, parang class adviser ang tanungan kay Vhong Navarro, na um-absent daw dahil sa ubo? Biro ni Meme, may nakarating sa kanyang kuwento. Ang sakit daw ni Vhong, hindi lang basta ubo? Sabi naman ng Mr. Suave, hindi gano'n ka-OA! He's perfectly okay!

Rated P! As in PASADO ang mga P-POP cuties na kasali sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Present ang WRIVE, 1621, VXON, AJAA, Cloud 7, at YGIG. Kalahati ng mapapanalunan ng lucky player ay ido-donate sa Helping Hands Healing Hearts Ministries.

Dahil P-Pop members ang bisita, kantahan at sayawan ay hindi mawawala. Nagpakitang-gilas sina VXON Sam at Franz, at nagbigay ng advice sa mga aspiring P-Pop stars. Pero kung si Jackie Gonzaga ang mag-o-audition, biro ni Meme, hindi papasa dahil P-Pop, as in P-Pangit ang boses ni Jackie. Aray naman, Meme!

Umaray rin si Vice Ganda nang mapag-usapan ang role ni Franz sa grupo. Dahan-dahan lang daw sa pagsabi ng 'MAIN VOCAL.' IYKYK. Baka pwedeng 'mang-aawit' na lang?

Pagkatapos ng fun challenges, si um-arrive ang swerte para kay Ishiro ng grupong WRIVE. Sinubukan ni Kim Chiu na kumbinsihin si Ishiro na tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer. Pero, nag-goodbye siya agad sa P20,000 para sa chance na sagutin ang P100,000 POT question.


Kung first day ng school para sa ibang estudyante, first day rin ng Grand Finals ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.

Sa unang araw ng bakbakan, sina Crisler Aporbo (Region XIII), Timmy Go (CAR), at Charlie Palalisan (Region XII) ang naglaban-laban,

Swabe ang tama ng performance ni Crisler, na binigyan ng bagong tunog ang classic OPM rock song na "Laklak." Dahil papalapit na sa dulo, itinodo na ni Timmy ang talento at ginawang mas masarap ang tunog ng "Saving All My Love For You." Abot-langit naman ang feels sa mapusong pag-awit ni Charlie ng "In The Stars" by Benson Boone.

Para sa Grand Finals, magkakaroon ng Round 2 ang bawat laban. Muling nagharap ang Top 2 scorers of the day, sina Charlie at Crisler. Sa ikalawang round, parehong naging mapuso ang pag-awit ni Charlie ng "Kung Wala Ka" oroginally by Hale, at ni Crisler, na ginawang ballad ang "Di Ko Na Mapipigilan" ng The Sexbomb Girls.

Parehong nagbigay ng matinding laban pero sa araw na ito, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat sa tanghalan. At ito ay si Charlie, na nakakuha ng score ng 93%.

title: Laugh trip! Vice, pinakita kung paano umangkas sa motor!
description:
HuweBEST kantahan ang sumalubong sa Madlang People! Isang pangmalakasang Air Supply performance ang pinerform nina "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" male champions JM Dela Cerna, Christian Tibayan, Riven Umali, JM Yosures, at Yannie Basical.

Magulo man ang usapan paminsan-minsan pero ang talakan ay naitatawid naman. Tamang laro lang sa "Miss Q and A" with candidates Cola Jane, Veena Loca Latak, at Ramona Baluno.

Na-test ang patience ni Vice Ganda dahil sa mga kandidata. Medyo not listening ang mga 'vadeng' kaya si Meme Vice, gulong-gulo sa usapan, pero gayunpaman, hindi mapigil ang halakhakan. Si Ramona, may malaking problema. Hindi siya nakapag-exam sa eskwela dahil daw sa "Miss Q and A," kaya ang sabi ni Meme, ayaw niyang madamay sa kabulastugan ng kandidata.

Hirit ni Meme, bagsak na sa school, 'lotlot' pa sa contest dahil si Ramona ang unang naligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Samantala, sa WIT Lang, umikot man nang bahagya pero nakarating naman sa finish line ang chukchak ni Cola sa tanong na, "Naha-heartbroken din ba ang puso ng saging?" Full of confidence rin ang pagtalak ni Veena as she took on the question, "Sino ang magulang ng anak pawis?"

Ang mga taga-Malabon, kumasa sa hamon. Sino kaya ang pinaka-lucky sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ngayon?

Aliw na medyo 'loading' at 'struggle is real' ang kuwentuhan ng hosts with nanay Marita, na tubong-Malabon talaga. Maya-maya pa, si Vice Ganda napagod na. Pero na-touch din siya sa kabutihan ni Marita, na pinaalala sa kan'ya ang lambing ng isang ina.

Chill naman ang chikahan with Jocar, na mula sa pagiging rider ay magsisimula na sa bagong trabaho sa call center. Paano nga ba dapat umangkas sa motor? Si Vice Ganda, may pag-demo! Sa paalog-alog niyang galawan, siguradong ika'y mapapa-LOL!

Ang swerte ay dumapo kay player Mari. Para bang lucky charm niya ang kanyang 'moon' tattoo na simbolo ng 'liwanag sa dilim.' Speaking of tattoos, ni-reveal din ni Vice Ganda ang dalawa sa tattoos niya, while the other hosts shared kung ano ang gusto nilang ipa-tattoo kung may pagkakataon.

title: Tanong ni Ralph: Date o Halik?
description:
Bugtong-bugtong, may korona ang hari, may kandila ang cake. Birthday ng Sample King kaya ang buong "It's Showtime" stage ay na-shake. Kasama ang unica hija na si Sarina, ipinagdiwang ni Jhong Hilario ang kaarawan niya.

Bago magsimula ang Miss Q and A segment, it's time para sa inaabangan din na kumustahan at chikahan ng trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Mula sa puksaan ng kasuotan hanggang sa asaran ng edad, lahat na 'ata napag-usapan ng magkakaibigan.

Samantala, mga dalubhasa sa pagtalak sina Miss Q&A candidates Dhey Pascual Abital, Beshie, at Erwina Tirambulo. Kung sa nakaraang episode ay nagpakilala ang mga kandidata at hosts with their love status, ngayon naman ay pabonggahan sila ng intro borrowing the acronyms of executive agencies sa Pilipinas.

DOJ, as in Diretso ang Opinyon, Jaw-dropping ang perfromances ng mga kandidata sa pagsagot sa pageant questions. Sina Dhey at Beshie ang umabante sa Wit Lang round.

Bumoses si Dhey tungkol sa pagbabayad ng buwis at epekto ng korapsyon as she answered the question, "Kung kinain ka na ng sistema, may nakuha ba silang sustansya?" It's better to give than to receive naman ang talak ni Beshie sa tanong na, "Kung binabalot ka ng kalungkutan pwede ka bang iregalo?"

Hindi 'to kuwentong barbero. Totoong nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga masisipag na barberong swabe ang dating. Time out muna sa paggamit ng gunting, sa pagsayaw at pagsagot muna nila ipapakita ang galing.

Enjoy ang hosts sa kuwentuhan kay Jun, ang loving hubby at daddy, na pangarap mapagpatapos ang anak sa kolehiyo. Dahil sa pangarap ni Jun, nakaramdamn ng lungkot si Vice Ganda. Naisip niyang sa Pilipinas, itinuturing na "pangarap" ang diploma, pero kung tutuusin ito ay "basic need na dapat naibibigay sa lahat ng mga bata.

Give na give ang players sa mga challenges sa game arena, hanggang sa may isang natira, si John. May pabaon na swerte ang kanyang buntis na misis. Nakapag-uwi si John ng P40,000 matapos tanggapin ang offer. Nanghinayang nga lang si John dahil alam niya ang sagot sa POT question. Kaya dinagdagan ni Vice ng P10,000 ang papremyo ng barbero.

title: Bigyan ng P150k 'yan! Tatay Wil, nasagot ang POT question!
description:
Kilig-kiligan ang kantahan sa “It’ Showtime” dahil isang mapusong harana ang hatid ng “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” male champions na sina JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, Christian Tibayan, Yannie Basical, at JM Dela Cerna. Bumisita rin sina “PBB Gen 11” alums Jarren Garcia at Dingdong Bahan para sa maghatid ng good news sa kanilang fans.

Ang mga sagot ng kandidata, siguradong pag-uusapan dahil sa Miss Q and A, intense na naman ang talakan. Bagay sa korona ang pangalan ng mga kandidatang sina Kylie Prinsesa at Princess Vajar. Pero si Candidate #3 na naiiba, Noriel Rodriguez Nabing, feeling daw niya siya ang wicked stepsister.

Itinaas ng mga ‘accla’ ang kanilang bandera as they proudly shared na malaya nilang nagagawa ang mga bagay na limitado sa mga ‘beki’ noon. Ang isang simpleng halimbawa na nabanggit ni Vice Ganda, ang mga beki raw noon ay expected na matutunan ang larong basketball, na kilala bilang sports na panlalaki. Pero ang mga beki ngayon, nakakapili na ng sports na gusto nila. Kaya na-open up ni Meme Vice ang 'unsettled grief' ng mga bakla noon.

Lighthearted kuwentuhan din ang pinagsaluhan ng mga Miss Q and A at "It's Showtime" hosts nang mabanggit ng isang kandidata ang lovelife niya. Binalikan ng "It's Showtime" family ang kanilang mga first love at old-school ways para magpapansin kay crush.

Pwede nang mangarap dahil may kulay at saya ang buhay para sa mga taga-Maricaban, Pasay. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, lumaban sila nang sabay-sabay. Pero sa challenges, hindi pwedeng sumablay.

Aliw naman ang aktingan sa Act-Song round na You Gotta Lyric. Si Ion Perez, minulto ni Emilio Daez? At heto pa ang mas matinding plot twist, si Ogie Alcasid humingi ng kiss kay Vhong Navarro!

Ang player na nagtagumpay sa mga challenges hanggang dulo ay walang iba kundi si Marlon. Dahil gusto ni Vice Ganda na madagdagan ang pera ni Marlon, binigyan niya ito ng pagkakataon na sagutin ang POT question.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Dedma sa ex na kumakatok at may pasalubong na paulit-ulit na pasakit. But, hello sa grupong nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" entablado para pagandahin ang araw n'yo. Napaindak ang buong nation sa performance at taas ng energy ng P-Pop group VXON.

Dazzling sa pagrampa sina Miss Q and A Resbakulawan candidates Andrea Jane Peralta, Jers Sabado, at Mama Dhel. Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang. Pagkatapos, sina Andrea at Jers ang umabante sa BEKLAMATION.

Na-impress si hurado Nicole Cordoves, pero aminadong nakulangan nang kaunti sa 'chukchak' ng dalawang ladies. Kaya para iwas-bitin, pati si Vice Ganda ay tumalak na rin! Sa huli, itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era Resbakulawan daily winner si Andrea.

Hindi na kailangan pang tumama sa lotto para masabing lucky sa araw na 'to! Dahil swerte agad ang lumapit sa mga taga-San Isidro, Cainta Rizal na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa "It's Showtime."

Walang mapapagod kakatawa sa mga challenges sa game arena. Sa paboritong Act-Song portion sa You Gotta Lyric round, time-out muna sa kilig scenes sina Brent Manalo at Jackie Gonzaga dahil magkapatid muna sila sa isang eksena ng family drama.

Hindi naman horror story ang pagsali ni player Pao. Dahil matapos ma-eliminate, nabunot ang pangalan niya upang maglaro sa jackpot round dahil bigo ang mga naunang players na ma-secure ang spot.

Ramdam ni Vice Ganda ang matinding pangangailangan ni Pao, isang siomai vendor na nag-iipon para sa kanyang operasyon sa mata dahil sa kondisyon na keratoconus. Ramdam din nito ang puso ng manlalaro. Kaya para bang binigyan niya ito ng lakas ng loob na sugalan ang POT question.

Pigil ang hininga ng Madlang People at lahat ng nasa studio, hanggang sa isinigaw ni Pao ang sagot. Bumuhos ang emosyon at saya nang i-anunsyo ni Vice Ganda na tama ang sagot ni Pao at maiuuwi nito ang P350,000 POT money.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Get your Saturday dose of motivation mula kina Vhong Navarro, Jhong Hilario, at Vice Ganda, na nagbahagi ng mensahe as we celebrate World Mental Heath Day.

Paalala ng trio, magpahinga. Sabi nga ni Meme Vice, ang pahinga ay hindi dapat reward lamang matapos mapagod o maubos ang lakas, kundi dapat bahagi ng routine. Hindi kailangang hintaying sagad na sagad na tayo bago huminto at huminga.

Libre lang talaga ang mangarap kaya lakasan ang loob. Sa pamamagitan ng talak na maningning, abutin ang mga bituin. Isang pangmalakasang "Miss Q and " weekly finals ang hatid nina Jeraldine Brittany Hawthorne, JC Ibale, Arci Simon, Jass Lucky, Cola Jane, at Angel Umbac.

Mula sa anim na weekly finalists, apat ang umabante sa Wit Lang round, hanggang ang Top 2 na sina Cola Jane at Arci ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan nasubok ang kanilang paniniwala nang tanungin kung papayag ba sila na may girl best friend ang kanilang boyfriend.

POT money na P100,000 ang goal na masungkit ng mga taga-Caniogan na sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, with hosts Karylle, Ogie Alcasid, at guest co-host Bianca Umali.

Si player Emo, still waiting for 'the one.' Kaya si Ogie, may payo. Huwag mag-alinlangan na ipagdasal ang taong hinahanap at hinihintay ng puso. Pagpapautang ng biskwit naman ang hanapbuhay ni Glo. Medyo magulo lang mala-slow burn na usapan pero nakarating naman!

Tingnan mo nga naman, sina Emo at Gloria ang natira sa You Gotta Lyric round. Pero hindi nila nahulaan ang pamagat ng mga kanta sa eksena, kaya bumunot ng eliminated player na maglalaro sa jackpot round, at ito ay si Doris.

title: Miss Q&A BEKLAMATION
description:
Sa isang Sabadong makulay, mga beki na fierce ang nagpamalas ng wit at nagpalaganap ng good vibes sa unang weekly finals ng "Miss Q and A."

Kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagrampa sina Miss Jawo ng Antipolo City, Kelly Agustin ng Nueva Ecija, Elisse Kagandahan Alamo ng Quezon City, Miss Mia ng Malolos Bulacan, Andrea Jane ng Del Monte Quezon City, at Barbie Bratz Ayuda ng Trece Martires Cavite.

Agad uminit ang puksaan ng mga kandidata dahil lahat ay sumabak with full confidence. Sina Barbie Bratz at Miss Jawo, mainit ang dugo sa isa't isa. Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kung sino pang magkamukha, sila pa ang nag-aaway!

Mula sa anim na nagpabilisan at nagpatalinuhan sa 'TumPAK Ganern' round, apat lang ang umabante sa 'WIT Lang' kung saan self-expression at pagiging creative sa mga sagot ang naging labanan. Sina Miss Jawo, Barbie, Kelly at Elisse ang pumasok sa second round.

At mula naman sa kanilang apat, sina Miss Jawo ang Kelly ang nag-face-off sa BEKLAMATION kung saan iisang tanong lamang ang kanilang sinagot. Ito ay kung anong makeup product ang ibibigay nila sa kanilang tatay.

Parehong 'lipstick' ang naisip nilang sagot, pero nagkaiba sa lalim ng paliwanag. Mas tumatak kina hurado Alexa Ilacad, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kelly, kaya siya ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna TalakERA of the week! Nakakuha si Kelly ng average score na 9.3, samantalang 8 naman ang grado ni Miss Jawo.

Masaya ang selebrasyon para sa mga tatay na puno ng dedikasyon. Minsan seryoso, minsan ay korni ang banat. Pero kahit magkakaiba, pagmamahal at sipag nila ay palaging sapat. Happy Father's Day sa mga madlang tatay!

Saludo tayo sa pagsisikap ni Mel, ang hardworking daddy, na walang sinasayang na oras sa pag-aalaga at pagtatrabaho for his family. Perfect naman for the celebration ang good vibes na dala ng Showtime hosts na sumalang sa bagong paboritong aktingan ng bayan, ang 'You Gotta Lyric' round.

Sina Vice at Vhong Navarro, parang na-enjoy ang 'physical' acting... parang totoo?! Heto ang siguradong totoo, para kay Mel ang araw na 'to! Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players, pangalan niya ang nabunot para maglaro sa jackpot round.

Dahil minsan lang ang ganitong experience, hindi nagpatinag si Mel na piliin ang POT question. May reward from the universe ang masisipag at matatapang! Dahil sa pagsugal niya sa POT, naiuwi ni Mel ang papremyong P300,000!

#TalakanSaShowtime
#ABSCBNEntertainment 
#ItsShowtime

title: Miss Q&A, naging 'PISIKALAN'?
description:
Over the moon ang saya sa pagbisita ni “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” pride Carmelle Collado, fresh from her recent Eurovision Asia journey. Napili ang kantang in-interpret ni Carmelle, "Sobra-Sobra," bilang entry ng Pilipinas sa unang Eurovision Song Contest Asia.

At siyempre, kumpleto ang September 1 dahil hindi lang basta sumilip kundi live na live ang Chan-ta ng Pinas, Jose Mari Chan. Nagkatotoo ang 'memes' nang personal niyang dalhin ang Christmas feels sa “It’s Showtime.”

Wish upon a star, mga kandidata, wit at confidence nila ay on full display. Sina Ringo Antonio, Gina Ganda, at Franco Gray ang nagpakitang-gilas sa “It’s Showtime” today.

Ang trip nila, sumabak sa sayawan. May bonus performance pa si Franco, na inilabas ang kanyang action-star moves a la Coco. Pero kung hataw na hataw sila sa dance floor, medyo napaisip naman ang ating queens pagdating sa tanungan sa “Tumpak Ganern.”

Ang Wit Lang, naging exciting dahil sa face-off nina Franco at Ringo. Napunta kay Franco ang tanong na, “Bakit pa tinatawag na rush hour kung hindi naman umaandar ang traffic?” Samantala, napaisip si Ringo kung maninigarilyo pa ba ang kapre kahit may hika ito.

Habang binibilang ang mga araw bago dumating ang Christmas bonus, sa "It's Showtime" muna makilaro. Malay mo, may naghihintay na aguinaldo. Swerte kaya ay dumating nang big para sa mga taga-Lower Bicutan, Taguig.

Kilig ang regalo nina Jackie Gonzaga at Darren Espanto. Si Darren, hindi makatingin nang diretso sa ka-eksena, kaya tumawag ng 'take two' si Vice Ganda. Hirit naman ni Kim Chiu, baka hindi makatingin kasi may "feelings" na?!

Ginalingan ni massage therapist Roy sa mga challenges kaya siya ang nakakuha ng spot sa Jackpot Round, kung saan P100,000 ang naghihintay. Para sa anak na nasa autism spectrum, pinili niyang lakasan ang loob at sunggaban ang pagkakataon.

description: Explore the origins, rise and social impact of QAnon, whose story has been told to the public one outrageous headline at a time. A comprehensive investigation into the who, what, and why of the viral movement.

title: Miss Q and A
description:
Here to brighten your day, bumisita si Iñigo Pascual para haranahin tayo sa kanta niyang "Ikaw At Ikaw." Ikaw na, Iñigo! Ikaw na ang kakasa sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance challenge!

Ang mga Miss Q and A ladies, nag-transform from kandidata to comedians real quick! Nagharapan sa talakan sina Iya Zaga Arkanghel ng Laguna, Miss Mia ng Bulacan, at Toni Fowler ng Cavite.

Pinalakpakan ang kanilang galawan at confidence sa rampahan. Ang ‘amats’ nilang tatlo, hindi kayang itago! Pati si Vice Ganda ay naloka sa sagot ng mga kandidata. Kelan pa nging ‘fishda’ ang ingles ng bangus? Nawindang din si Meme sa dilim ng kili-kili ni Toni! Maya-maya pa, sina Iya at Miss Mia ang umabante sa Round 2. Sino ang mas aangat sa talakan?

Salamat sa kanilang sipag, napapanatiling malinis ang ating paligid. Kaya naman deserve nila ang bumida sa 'Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sila ang mga madlang utility workers.

Sa kuwento ni Berto, parang may nag-awoo! Bilang utility worker sa isang ospital, sanay na siya sa mga paramdam, hindi ng ex na nang-ghost, kundi ng mga kakaibang 'nilalang' na paikot-ikot, patakbo-takbo sa ospital na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan.

Kung tumaas ang 'yong balahibo sa kwento ni Berto, tataas naman panigurado ang level of happiness mo sa magulong aktingan sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Parang pelikula na kumpleto ang casting, sanib-pwersa sa pag-Act-Song ang paborito nating quadro—Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario.

Ang mommy of walo na si Riz ang umabante sa final stage ng laro. Swerte nga ba ang numerong otso? Nag-goodbye si Nanay Riz sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000, para sugalan ang P25,000 POT question.

Creative and resourceful, Pootle and his friends find fun and adventure wherever they go, with stories that will spark children's imaginations everywhere! We are not alone... Isn't that nice to know?

title: NAHULI ANG PAG-IRAP ng Miss Q&A candidate
description:
Enjoy lang sa pasiklaban ang mga kandidatang bitbit ang bandera ng sangkabaklaan.

Graduating student si Lixa Labbuanan, na dream maging flight attendant. Sa intro niya na "walang retoke," si Vice Ganda, nag-react, na para bang tinamaan?! Rapping naman ang talent ni Kim Nunez, pero hindi nagpakabog si Candiate 3, Scarlet Gajol, na rumatsada rin sa eme-emeng rap kaya ang Madlang People hindi matigil sa pag-laugh!

Kung si Scarlet ay magiging rap artist, tatawagin siyang 'Raf Ref Rif Rof Ruf.' Pagdating sa TumPak Ganern, tawanan ay through the roof dahil sa mali-mali niyang sagot! Ang English ng "kuko," sabi niya ay "nipa hut." Sino nga ba ang may kasalanan? Si Scarlet na sumagot, o si Meme Vice na nagtatanong lang naman?

Sa Round 2 na WIT Lang, sina Lixa at Kim ang naglaban! Nabunot ni Lixa ang tanong tungkol sa mararamdaman niya 'pag nakapatay ng lamok na breadwinner. Si Kim naman ay pasasalamat ang binanggit nang matanong kung anong gagawin kapag binigyan siya ng isang ektaryang lupa na nakasako.

Mga mahal nating lolo't lola, bumida at na-experience ang saya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Si Tatay Pabling, pinatunayan ang pagiging Solid Showtimer dahil kabisado niya ang pangalan ng mga hosts! Perfect, walang nakalimutan! Masayahin si tatay, at masaya rin ang buhay kasama si misis, na apat na dekada na niyang iniibig!

Hindi mo naman makakalimutang tumawa sa mga eksena for today's video. Hindi naman siya ang naglaro sa jackpot round, pero si Jackie Gonzaga ang pumaldo sa kilig nang pag-agawan nina Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto. Si Vice Ganda, napag-trip-an na naman nina Jhong Hilario at Vhong Navarro, ginawang manika 'yan siya!

Si Mommy Jo ang umabante sa jackpot round, kung saan P100,000 ang pwede niyang mapanalunan. Ngunit para sigurado, Li-Pot offer na P25,000 ang pinili ni Mommy Jo. May special offer din si Meme, na dodoblehin daw ang P25k kung sakaling masasagot ni Mommy Jo ang POT question.

title: Beyond the Valley of the Dolls: Cast and Crew Q&A
description: Q&A session from a 1990 revival theater screening of the cult classic Beyond the Valley of the Dolls (1970).

title: Vice, nawindang sa Miss Q&A! Nanawagan sa DepEd!
description:
Salubungin ang July with champion biritan kasama nina TNT Duets 2 champs Christian Tbayan at Arvery Lagoring. Nagkaisa naman ang mga 'accla' sa Miss Q and A segment. Ang kanilang chika, bawasan ang problema at dagdagan ang saya. Ipinanalo nina Pia Cayetatayno, Mama Dhel, at Samaya Jhay ang protesta kontra bad vibes.

Isa-isang inilatag ng mga kandidata ang mga paandar nilang intro, drawing laughter from the Madlang People in the studio. Si Vice Ganda, may napansin sa tatlong kandidata. Kung si Pia ay may mga matang ala Meryll Soriano, si Mama Dhel naman daw ay mukhang 'baby' na 36 years overdue.

Nang magsimula ang unang round, ang nasabi na lang ni Meme ay, "Diyos ko!" dahil sa sagot ng mga kandidata for today's video. Sa tanong na, "Ano ang plural ng salitang furniture?" sumagot ang isang kandidata, na para bang sure na sure, "Super furnitures."

Kaya si Meme, 'nanginig' at nag-react nang pabiro, "Nananawagan talaga kami sa Department of Education. Gumalaw na tayo."

Sina Mama Dhel at Samaya Jhay ang nagharap sa ikalawang round, Wit Lang. Ang pinusuan ng mga hurado ay si Mama Dhel bilang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra sa araw na 'to.

Pumuti man ang kanilang buhok, nananatili namang makulay ang sense of humor ng mga beloved lolo't lola from Meycauayan, Bulacan na nakisaya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Mga 'veterans' as in veterans sa pagpapatawa naman ang nagsama-sama sa You Gotta Lyric round na bagong inaabangan ng "It's Showtime" fans. Madlang People ay napa-wow nang si Vice Ganda ay lumabas bilang MemeRimar! Aww!

Ang happy ending sa kuwentong 'to ay para kay Tatay Philip, na umabante sa dulo ng laro. Positive lang ang pananaw ni tatay sa buhay. Aniya, pumunta siya sa "It's Showtime" nang walang dala, kaya aalis siyang sapat na ang P30,000 na Li-Pot offer.
